title: Sentinel-2 TrueColor (TEST)
description: TEST COLLECTION -- not for production use. Exercises the dps-output-discover Lambda end to end: routing, relocation into ProgramData/, and the veda_discover DAG trigger. Discovers from ProgramData/Sentinel-2/TestTrueColor/, seeded with real files copied from ProgramData/Sentinel-2/TrueColor/. The prefix deliberately does NOT begin with 'TrueColor': sentinel2-truecolor-daily declares the slash-less prefix ProgramData/Sentinel-2/TrueColor with filename_regex .*_day\.tif$, so any folder named TrueColor* would have every one of its files claimed by that collection as well as this one. Matches _day.tif because that is the only naming convention present in the source folder -- the .*Z\.tif$ form matches nothing there. Safe to delete once the pipeline is verified.
